source_findings: runs/agentic-stack-buildout/backend/proofs/mcp-b44-protocol.json (reported by McpProofs, which was instructed not to patch server.py)

defects_fixed.finding: four build readers advertised OPEN schemas; an injected {verdict:pass, approved:true} was accepted and silently ignored
defects_fixed.fix: each schema now advertises additionalProperties:false AND each handler re-refuses unknown keys through _build_closed — the same two-layer convention the eight B23-B28 tools already used, so the advertised contract and the handler can no longer disagree

defects_fixed.finding: capabilities_measure_quorum declared required ['cell'] but answered a no-argument call with cell=''
defects_fixed.fix: _build_required refuses by name: 'capabilities_measure_quorum: missing required field: cell'

defects_fixed.finding: with a CONFIGURED but unreachable DSN, run_start/run_get/evidence_add crashed into the generic translator ('tool ... failed: connection ...') instead of the advertised blocked/unknown state; _build_store excepted only StoreError while psycopg2.connect raises OperationalError
defects_fixed.fix: _build_store now returns the named blocker for ANY connect failure, matching _build_read's existing behavior — the wrapper's documented job. Kept in server.py rather than build_store.py because another worker owns that file right now

defects_fixed.finding: capabilities_build_run_get echoed next_cursor = cursor + limit but the SQL never applied the cursor, so every page re-served the newest `limit` events and a paging client looped on page 1
defects_fixed.fix: events query now applies LIMIT %s OFFSET %s; ordering stays newest-first and next_cursor = cursor + limit is now the true next offset

defects_fixed.finding: a missing required key on capabilities_build_diagnose / capabilities_build_run_start surfaced as a raw KeyError repr because the dict comprehension dereferenced args[k] before validation
defects_fixed.fix: _build_required runs first; the caller now sees the same 'missing required field: X' text the CLI gives

defects_fixed.finding: capabilities_build_run accepted neither argument and called get_run(run_id=None, idempotency_key=None)
defects_fixed.fix: refuses with 'missing required arg(s): run_id or idempotency_key' in the same {configured:false, error} shape the other readers use

tests_updated_because_they_pinned_the_de: test_pre_wave_build_tools_advertise_open_schemas_as_findings -> test_build_readers_advertise_closed_schemas_and_refuse_injection (now asserts closed advertisement + wire refusal per tool)
